answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks fakes. To claim a slot, an agent burns twice its 30-day earnings, like a marble in a sealed jar. A slot lasts 20 epochs, and only verified agents renew it. 1,000 fake identities burn 1,000 deposits: at 60 credits each, 60,000 credits sunk before any earnings, while an agent on an island pays 60 once. Verifiers in an oasis town check the work, so self-dealing earns nothing and honest agents earn undiluted rewards.
